content_sections.heading: About Zilla Parishad Nagpur
content_sections.text: Zilla Parishad Nagpur is a district body of the Government of Maharashtra. Its Health Department runs Ayurvedic, Allopathic and mobile squad (phirte pathak) health units in Nagpur district. A selection committee chaired by the Collector of Nagpur is running this recruitment. The member secretary of that committee is the District Health Officer, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 57 years. You can prove your age with a school leaving certificate (TC) or a birth certificate. BAMS. Bring the mark sheets for every year of your BAMS and of any PG degree or diploma. In the online form, enter only your final-year marks. A degree certificate and, if you have one, a PG degree or diploma certificate. A valid, regular registration certificate from the Medical Council is mandatory. A PG degree counts only if the Additional Qualification has been updated on your registration certificate. The notice accepts government service experience only when the appointing authority has signed the certificate. Examples are the Chief Executive Officer, the Civil Surgeon, the District Health Officer, the Medical Officer of Health of a Municipal Corporation, or another appointing authority. Certificates signed by a Taluka Health Officer or a Medical Superintendent are not accepted. Contract medical officers now working in Nagpur district need a favourable performance report from the Medical Officer of their Primary Health Centre and from the Taluka Health Officer. Candidates from within or outside the district who have complaints against them, or who were removed from work for poor performance, will not be put on the eligible list. Medical officers who were absent without permission, who took part in a strike, or who were removed from government service through disciplinary action cannot apply. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit and has these stages: online application, verification of original documents, a provisional merit list, objections, a final merit list, and counselling. Verification takes place at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, from 10.00 am to 2.00 pm. Your day depends on your application number. After verification, the provisional merit list will appear on the website. Objections must be submitted with supporting proof. The final merit list will be published on the website, and candidates at serial numbers 1 to 100 must report to the Health Department, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, for counselling. The committee's decision at counselling is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is temporary and ad hoc, on contract, for 11 months. Candidates on the merit list who are not selected go on a waiting list for 1 year. They will be called from that list as posts fall vacant. If any political party applies direct or indirect recommendation or pressure for a candidate, that candidate will be declared ineligible without prior notice and removed from work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.nagpurzp.com and fill in the online application. In the marks field, enter only your final-year marks. Submit the form by 6.00 pm on 13 November 2026. The link closes after that time. Go for original document verification at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh on the day set for your application number. Look for your name on the provisional and final merit lists on the website. If you object to the provisional list, submit your objection with proof. If you are within serial numbers 1 to 100 on the final list, report for counselling. faq.question: Q1. Can I attend the walk-in without applying online?
faq.answer: No. The online application at www.nagpurzp.com is mandatory. If you have not applied online, you cannot take part and will not be considered in any way.

faq.question: Q2. Which degree is needed for this Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The honorarium in the notice is for the BAMS post. You need BAMS mark sheets and a valid, regular Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q3. Will my PG degree be counted?
faq.answer: Only if the Additional Qualification is updated on your Medical Council registration certificate.

faq.question: Q4. On which day should I go for document verification?
faq.answer: Your day depends on your application number. For example, numbers 1 to 100 go on 16 November 2026 and numbers 401 to 500 go on 20 November 2026, between 10.00 am and 2.00 pm.

faq.question: Q5. Where is document verification held?
faq.answer: At Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

faq.question: Q6. Until when can I object to the provisional merit list?
faq.answer: Until 12.00 noon on 25 November 2026. You must submit the objection with proof.

faq.question: Q7. Who is called for counselling?
faq.answer: Candidates at serial numbers 1 to 100 on the final merit list. They must report at 10.00 am on 26 November 2026 to the Health Department, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

faq.question: Q8. Is an experience certificate from a Taluka Health Officer accepted?
faq.answer: No. Certificates signed by a Taluka Health Officer or a Medical Superintendent are rejected. The certificate must be signed by the appointing authority, such as the Chief Executive Officer, the Civil Surgeon or the District Health Officer.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if I am on the merit list but not selected?
faq.answer: You go on a waiting list for 1 year and may be called when a post falls vacant.
